workflows.content:
# 中文：使用 GitHub 自动运行 M0 第一批 P0 业务函数回归，不调用 Codex。
# English: Run M0 first-batch P0 regression on GitHub without Codex.
name: M0 P0 Regression
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261009-m0-p0-fixes
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  m0-p0:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Node version
        run: node --version
      - name: Run real M0 business-function checks
        run: node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs

# 中文：新 P1 分支上同时复验上一批 P0 与第二批 P1。
# English: Re-run both existing P0 and new P1 regressions on the P1 draft branch.
name: M0 P0 P1 Regression
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261009-m0-p1-fixes
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  m0-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Node version
        run: node --version
      - name: P0 regression
        run: node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs
      - name: P1 regression
        run: node tests/m0-p1-regression.cjs

# 中文：在 GitHub 云端连续验证前三批修复，并发布虚构测试数据供采购员下载。
# English: Verify P0/P1/P2 cumulatively in GitHub Actions and publish synthetic fixtures for buyer testing.
name: M0 P0 P1 P2 Regression
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261009-m0-p2-fixes
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - name: Checkout draft branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Runtime
        run: node --version
      - name: Generate 100-item 10-supplier synthetic fixtures
        run: node tests/generate-m0-fixtures.cjs
      - name: P0 regression
        run: node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs
      - name: P1 regression
        run: node tests/m0-p1-regression.cjs
      - name: P2 regression
        run: node tests/m0-p2-regression.cjs
      - name: Upload synthetic CSV fixture package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m0-100x10-synthetic-csv
          path: tests/fixtures/generated/*.csv
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

# 中文：云端真实 Chromium 验收，必须先通过基本操作才执行完整采购流程。
# English: Real cloud Chromium acceptance. Complete workflow runs only after basic UI passes.
name: M0 Playwright Browser Acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261009-m0-playwright-acceptance
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  basic:
    name: Basic real-browser interactions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Install Playwright
        run: |
          npm install --no-save playwright@1.56.1
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Generate reproducible synthetic fixture files
        run: node tests/generate-m0-fixtures.cjs
      - name: Re-run P0, P1, P2 source-logic regressions
        run: |
          node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p1-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p2-regression.cjs
      - name: Run BASIC real Chromium browser acceptance
        run: node tests/browser/basic.cjs
      - name: Upload basic failure evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m0-basic-browser-evidence
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30
  full:
    name: Full synthetic procurement workflow 100x10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: basic
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Install Playwright
        run: |
          npm install --no-save playwright@1.56.1
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Generate reproducible synthetic fixture files
        run: node tests/generate-m0-fixtures.cjs
      - name: Run FULL real Chromium procurement workflow
        run: node tests/browser/full.cjs
      - name: Upload full workflow evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m0-full-browser-evidence
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Upload reusable synthetic procurement CSVs
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m0-100x10-browser-verified-csv
          path: tests/fixtures/generated/*.csv
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

# 中文：先运行原有采购流程，再验收指定供应商组同范围比价的真实浏览器选择及下载。
# English: Recheck existing procurement workflow before real-browser acceptance of selected supplier comparison.
name: M0 Selected Supplier Common Scope Acceptance
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261009-m0-selected-common-scope
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  acceptance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Install Playwright Chromium
        run: |
          npm install --no-save playwright@1.56.1
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Generate anonymous 100-item 10-supplier samples
        run: node tests/generate-m0-fixtures.cjs
      - name: Validate prior P0 P1 P2 regressions
        run: |
          node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p1-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p2-regression.cjs
      - name: Validate selected supplier common-scope logic
        run: node tests/m0-common-scope-regression.cjs
      - name: Run prior browser basic regression
        run: node tests/browser/basic.cjs
      - name: Run buyer feedback browser regression
        run: node tests/browser/uat-feedback.cjs
      - name: Run complete 100x10 multi-round procurement workflow
        run: node tests/browser/full.cjs
      - name: Run selected supplier group scope and CSV browser checks
        run: node tests/browser/common-scope.cjs
      - name: Upload acceptance evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m0-selected-common-scope-browser-evidence
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

# 中文：人工 UAT 修复草稿分支在 GitHub 云端执行 Chromium 实际交互并保留失败证据。
# English: Real Chromium regressions for buyer-UAT fixes, with cloud evidence and no main-branch changes.
name: M0 Buyer UAT Feedback Browser Regression
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261009-m0-uat-feedback
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Install Chromium Playwright
        run: |
          npm install --no-save playwright@1.56.1
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Build anonymous multi-round quote CSV samples
        run: node tests/generate-m0-fixtures.cjs
      - name: Re-run P0, P1, P2 source regressions
        run: |
          node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p1-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p2-regression.cjs
      - name: Real-browser baseline
        run: node tests/browser/basic.cjs
      - name: Real-browser buyer UAT feedback
        run: node tests/browser/uat-feedback.cjs
      - name: Complete 100-item 10-supplier two-round workflow
        run: node tests/browser/full.cjs
      - name: Upload screenshots and test details
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m0-uat-feedback-browser-evidence
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

# English: Validate the minimal offline build and Chromium probe without changing accepted M0.

          if-no-files-found: ignore

name: M1 Lite Batch PDF Drawing Matching and Buyer Confirmation

  b0:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Build dependency-free standalone HTML
        run: node scripts/build-m1-b0.cjs
      - name: Check standalone build and safe failure mode
        run: node tests/m1-b0-logic.cjs
      - name: Validate serializable M1 core workspace and demo isolation
        run: node tests/m1-b1-model.cjs
      - name: Validate backup contract and reject malformed files
        run: node tests/m1-lite-portable-backup.cjs
      - name: Check supplier privacy, comparable-scope totals and revision history
        run: node tests/m1-lite-report-model.cjs
      - name: Validate all-RFQ backup format and compatibility
        run: node tests/m1-lite-bulk-backup.cjs
      - name: Verify conservative PDF filename and drawing-number matching
        run: node tests/m1-lite-drawing-matcher.cjs
      - name: Check PDF-capable safe ZIP handling
        run: node tests/m1-lite-drawing-zip.cjs
      - name: Generate independent Excel fixture workbooks
        run: |
          python -m pip install --quiet openpyxl==3.1.5
          python tests/generate-m1-lite-xlsx.py
      - name: Install browser test runtime
        run: |
          npm install --no-save playwright@1.56.1
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Real Chromium test using file URL
        run: node tests/browser/m1-b0.cjs
      - name: Verify actual M0 memory structures can round-trip in Chromium
        run: node tests/browser/m1-b1.cjs
      - name: Verify user-facing XLSX rejection and actual CSV imports
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-safe-import.cjs
      - name: Exercise buyer workspace and IndexedDB manual save in Chromium
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-manual-save.cjs
      - name: Verify independent repeated RFQs, archive switching and stale-tab rejection
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-multiple-rfqs.cjs
      - name: Verify bulk backup, selected/full restore and all-supplier ZIP with Chromium
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-bulk-backup-and-rfq.cjs
      - name: Browser acceptance for real PDF storage, linked drawings and full-package recovery
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-real-drawings.cjs
      - name: Real browser batch matching, manual review and confirmed PDF associations
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-batch-drawing-match.cjs
      - name: Independently verify PDF binary hashes and strict supplier ZIP scoping
        run: python tests/verify-m1-lite-real-drawings.py
      - name: Independently inspect per-supplier Excel files in ZIP
        run: python tests/verify-m1-lite-rfq-batch-zip.py
      - name: Verify downloadable backup and safe restore in Chromium
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-portable-backup.cjs
      - name: Check ERP headers and quote remarks in real browser
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-erp-fields-notes.cjs
      - name: Verify genuine XLSX imports and downloaded business workbook
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-native-xlsx.cjs
      - name: Independently validate downloaded Excel workbook
        run: python tests/verify-m1-lite-xlsx-export.py
      - name: Download supplier RFQ and price comparison in Chromium
        run: node tests/browser/m1-lite-report-exports.cjs
      - name: Independently validate both exported business Excel reports
        run: python tests/verify-m1-lite-report-xlsx.py
      - name: Generate anonymous M0 test fixtures before any M0 checks
        run: node tests/generate-m0-fixtures.cjs
      - name: Preserve existing M0 logic regressions
        run: |
          node tests/m0-p0-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p1-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-p2-regression.cjs
          node tests/m0-common-scope-regression.cjs
      - name: Preserve existing M0 full browser flow
        run: |
          node tests/browser/basic.cjs
          node tests/browser/uat-feedback.cjs
          node tests/browser/full.cjs
      - name: Upload synthetic offline diagnostic HTML
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: m1-lite-selectable-report-candidate
          path: prototype/m1-lite/index.html
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 30

# 中文：仅测试开发分支，使用虚构数据；不访问生产系统。
# English: Development-branch-only synthetic regression; no production data.
name: SRM S3/S4 Regression
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - draft/20261013-m1-storage-ui-audit
      - test/20261014-issue3-playwright
      - fix/20261020-s4-backup-dirty-guard
      - fix/20261020-s4-visible-block-feedback
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - draft/20261013-m1-storage-ui-audit
      - feat/20261019-srm-ui-v3-integration
      - fix/20261020-s4-backup-dirty-guard
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  regression:
    name: SQLite S4 restore and supplier ZIP regression on Windows
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the tested branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Run SQLite, full backup/restore and local API tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -v -s prototype/m1-lite/backend -p "test_*.py"
      - name: Run supplier ZIP and PDF regression
        run: node --test prototype/m1-lite/tests/autosave_rules.test.cjs prototype/m1-lite/tests/supplier_package.test.cjs
      - name: Verify launcher is ASCII and points to backend
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $script = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("prototype/m1-lite/run_local.bat")
          if ($script | Where-Object { $_ -ge 128 }) { throw "Launcher contains non-ASCII bytes" }
          $bat = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($script)
          if (-not $bat.Contains('%~dp0backend\server.py')) { throw "Launcher lost relative server path" }

  browser:
    name: Synthetic Chromium acceptance on Linux
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: python -m unittest discover -v -s prototype/m1-lite/backend -p "test_*.py"
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Retain synthetic browser evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        # 中文：附件存储额度耗尽时，证据上传失败不应覆盖业务回归结果。
        # English: Artifact storage failure must not override required regression results.
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: srm-playwright-evidence
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14

# 中文：统一 UI V2 验收候选，整套 B1-B3 + 探索修正均真实验收。
# English: Single acceptance workflow for approved B1-B3 UI and exploratory refinements.
name: SRM UI V2 Unified Candidate Acceptance
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - draft/20261013-m1-storage-ui-audit
      # 中文：PR24 集成候选的修复 PR 也必须执行完整 UI 验收。
      # English: Gate fixes targeting the PR24 integration branch with the full UI suite.
      - feat/20261019-srm-ui-v3-integration
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  linux-real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - name: Install locked Node dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Install real Chromium
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Check Python SQLite, complete backup and restoration logic
        run: python -m unittest discover -v -s prototype/m1-lite/backend -p 'test_*.py'
      - name: Check supplier quotation and workbook business rules
        run: npm test
      - name: Run complete real Chromium M1-Lite and UI V2 end-to-end acceptance
        run: npm run test:e2e
      - name: Archive screenshots, database test logs, HTML report and traces
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        # 中文：仓库附件额度耗尽时，上传证据不应覆盖真正的测试结果。
        # English: Artifact upload is best-effort and must not override required test results.
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: srm-ui-v2-candidate-chromium-evidence
          path: |
            test-results/
            playwright-report/
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
  windows-business-safety:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Verify Windows SQLite and backup restore
        run: python -m unittest discover -v -s prototype/m1-lite/backend -p "test_*.py"
      - name: Verify supplier packages and autosave rules
        run: node --test prototype/m1-lite/tests/autosave_rules.test.cjs prototype/m1-lite/tests/supplier_package.test.cjs
      - name: Validate Windows local launcher's encoding and relative path
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $data = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("prototype/m1-lite/run_local.bat")
          if ($data | Where-Object { $_ -ge 128 }) { throw "Windows launcher contains non-ASCII bytes" }
          $content = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($data)
          if (-not $content.Contains('%~dp0backend\server.py')) { throw "Windows launcher relative path changed" }
      - name: Validate isolated V2 pilot launcher does not use normal data directory
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $pilot = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("prototype/m1-lite/run_ui_v2_pilot.bat")
          if ($pilot | Where-Object { $_ -ge 128 }) { throw "Review launcher contains non-ASCII bytes" }
          $text = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($pilot)
          if (-not $text.Contains('SRM_DATA_DIR')) { throw "Isolated pilot data override missing" }
          if (-not $text.Contains('SRM-Lite-V2-Review')) { throw "Isolated review data folder missing" }
          if (-not $text.Contains('%~dp0backend\server.py')) { throw "Pilot relative backend path lost" }
          if ($text.Contains('rd /s') -or $text.Contains('rmdir /s')) { throw "Review script must not delete trial data" }
